bukti: We focus on the subtask of planning views so as to accurately estimate the number of apples in an apple cluster.
We present a method to efficiently enumerate combinatorially distinct world models and to compute the most likely model from one or more views.

bukti: This study used multispectral imaging and deep learning of the YOLO algorithm to detect the ripeness stages of oil palm FFBs on a moving conveyor.
Each FFB was scanned twice at the front and back sides.
with an AP of 99.69% for ripe and 99.62% for unripe, with IoU of 79.59% and mAP (@0.50) of 99.66%
catatan: Tiap tandan dipindai sisi depan dan belakang, tetapi setiap citra dan bingkai video dinilai sendiri tanpa penggabungan antarcitra, sehingga bukan C1. Tidak ada pencacahan. Hasil utama di Tabel 3, h. 11 PDF.

bukti: This paper presents a thorough examination of UAV datasets, emphasizing their wide range of applications and progress.
These datasets play a crucial role in disaster damage assessment, aerial surveillance, object recognition, and tracking.
catatan: Tinjauan dataset UAV umum tanpa buah; bukan tinjauan topik pencacahan buah dan bukan makalah metode, sehingga tidak memenuhi R maupun T. Penyebutan pelacakan dan re-identifikasi kendaraan dapat membuat peninjau lain memilih T.

bukti: requires re-checking the ripeness of fresh fruit bunches (FFB) at the collection point (TPH)
can be used to optimally detect, calculate, and classify the ripeness of the FFB
the dataset used consists of 4257 images taken directly from PTPN IV plantations. The results of this study showed good model performance, with an accuracy of 96.56%.

bukti: propose a system based on cutting-edge technologies, YOLOv8 and ByteTrack, to accurately detect and count fruits in real time
The comparison between the manual counting and the model showed an accuracy of 75.33 %.
